name: Pure Cycle Corporation
summary: Pure Cycle Corporation provides water and wastewater services in the United States. It operates in three segments: Water and Wastewater Resource Development, Land Development, and Single-Family Rental. The company owns or controls water supply and infrastructure to withdraw, treat, store and deliver water; collect, treat, and reuse wastewater; treat and deliver reclaimed water for irrigation and industrial use, including non-potable irrigation of parks and open spaces. It also provides raw water for industrial oil and gas operations; and wholesale water production, storage, treatment and distribution systems, and wastewater collection and treatment systems.
